versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-collector, a command-line tool for retrieving and analyzing Xiaohongshu (小红书) public data.

- Supports keyword search for notes, fetching note details & comments, and monitoring posts from specific users—no Xiaohongshu login required.
- Returns structured data suitable for topic research, competitive analysis, and content planning, with a maximum of 10,000 results per query.
- Offers flexible filtering by content type, sorting, publish time, and customizable result limits.
- Requires only a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for access; runs cross-platform via Node.js.
- Designed for marketers, analysts, and creators needing quick, large-scale Xiaohongshu data collection and insights.
